lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Maestro,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: do you know what Tetranet is by any chance?
Everyone is familiar with Tetranet.
It's a video-sharing platform.
Aria doesn't respond for a long time.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: You shouldn't look down on anyone

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: just because they don't know something.
I wasn't judging anyone.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: You knew too?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I feel so out of the loop.
Anyone living in the digital age knows about Tetranet.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I didn't...
... Well, there are always exceptions to the rule.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Good save.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: A while back, my troupe tried to get me

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: to set up my own official Tetranet channel.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Neither the opera house nor I

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: am sure if that's really necessary.
It's a good idea to have an official channel.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Why's that?
You can make money from advertising fees.
It helps you get your name out there.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I'm not disagreeing with you,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: but if I post videos on there,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: what reason would people have to come to the opera house?
There are already plenty of videos on the internet.
Seeing a video clip of you performing and seeing you in real life are two different things.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Yet again, I agree with you.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: But you can't deny that there are people

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: who would have come to see me in concert

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: if it weren't for the fact there were free videos online.
You know there are already hundreds of videos of you online, right?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: There are?
Of course, but fans are still coming to see you.
Aria doesn't answer for a long time.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I just searched my name on Tetranet...

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: You're right.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I've scrolled through 100 pages, and videos keep popping up.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: People can listen to my singing online so easily,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: but my concert tickets still sell out so quickly...
That's right.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I can't believe this.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I guess I underestimated my fans.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Thanks for hearing me out.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I'll get started on setting up my own official channel.
I'll be your first subscriber.
